title: 油价100美元：美国页岩油却不敢增产，今夏供应缺口谁来补？
speaker: Steven

segments.en: Well, you know, interestingly enough, when oil is at $60, $65, we were seeing the record of U.S. production. I was quite perplexed by that. Right now at $95, $100, a barrel of pollen, certainly prices are high enough. Now, they're high enough, but are they going to remain high?
segments.zh: 有趣的是，当油价在60-65美元时，美国产量创纪录，我当时很困惑。现在95-100美元，价格确实够高，但能维持吗？

segments.en: We are seeing some hints, particularly when we look at the CFTC data, they're commitment to trader's reports. When we look at the disaggregated portion of that report that serves as a proxy for E&P hedgers, then we're seeing a significant amount of futures markets sold forward.
segments.zh: 我们看到一些迹象，特别是CFTC持仓报告。在分项数据中，作为勘探生产商对冲代理的部分，我们看到大量期货被提前卖出。

segments.en: So what we can say with confidence is that E&P producers are selling this conflict. Now, the question is, are they selling it? And then they're going to meet that with future production, which would be the implication. We have to admit that remains to be seen.
segments.zh: 我们可以肯定的是，勘探生产商正在利用冲突溢价卖出。问题是他们是否会以未来产量来兑现，这还有待观察。

segments.en: But typically, the knock on is you'd want to see months of a new pricing regime that we are in, rather than just a kind of a short live. Okay, this is a market, a futures market that is trading with every whim, every social media post that comes out there. That's not a fundamental physical plan right now.
segments.zh: 但通常，你需要看到新价格机制持续数月，而不是短暂现象。目前期货市场受情绪和社交媒体影响，这不是基于基本面现货的计划。

segments.en: So we do know that is, again, I'll reiterate that a lot of oil has been sold forward by the producer class. Now, that could be a speculative hedge, it could be, but it's not. So the likelihood is we will start to see production ramp up to meet this.
segments.zh: 我们确实知道，生产商已经卖出了大量远期原油。这可能是一种投机性对冲，但并非如此。因此，我们很可能会看到产量增加以满足需求。

segments.en: But the question is, can we get that production from where it is, who needs to be in the amount of time that we need, and that is, the answer to that is no. So from a longer term perspective, we might see, the indications are there, but will it make enough of a difference to impact price without other factors being addressed for this summer unlikely now?
segments.zh: 但问题是，我们能否在需要的时间内将产量提升到所需水平？答案是否定的。从长期看，有迹象表明产量会增加，但能否足以影响今夏价格，而不解决其他因素？目前不太可能。
